title: 花果山重聚
subtitle: 回到熟悉的地方，也要听听新的变化
origin: 《西游记》第四至五回（低龄温和改编补遗）

moral.zh: 回家不只是讲自己的见闻，也要听伙伴说说这段时间发生了什么。
moral.en: Coming home is not only sharing our adventures. It is also listening to what changed while we were away.

pages.zh: 悟空从天庭回到花果山，群猴捧着桃子和花，一路跑来迎接。
pages.en: Wukong returned from Heaven, and the monkeys raced to welcome him with peaches and flowers.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] On Flower-Fruit Mountain, smaller gray-brown monkeys with cream faces welcome Wukong; he keeps the red-and-gold staff upright beside him.

pages.zh: 悟空正想讲天马园的趣事，小猴子却指着一条被雨水冲坏的山路。
pages.en: Wukong was ready to tell stories of the celestial horses, but a young monkey pointed to a rain-damaged path.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] A young monkey points toward a shallow washed-out section of mountain path while Wukong stops and listens; no cliff or danger.

pages.zh: “先听你们说。”悟空收起金箍棒，坐在石头上，让大家一个一个讲。
pages.en: “You tell me first.” Wukong stored the staff and sat on a stone as everyone took turns speaking.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] The staff is safely shrunk behind Wukong's ear as he sits at the same height as the monkeys and listens to each speaker.

pages.zh: 原来大雨冲走了踏脚石，桃篮运不过去，小猴子们只好绕很远。
pages.en: Rain had washed away the stepping stones, forcing the monkeys carrying peach baskets to take a long detour.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] Wukong and monkeys inspect a gentle muddy gap where flat stepping stones are missing; peach baskets wait safely on dry ground.

pages.zh: 悟空没有一棒敲下去，而是先用细绳量宽度，再找来扁平石块。
pages.en: Wukong did not strike the ground. He measured the gap with cord and chose flat stones.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] Wukong uses a soft measuring cord while monkeys sort broad flat stones; the staff remains vertical in a safe holder.

pages.zh: 大家分工搬石、填沙、压稳。悟空只在最后用金箍棒轻轻测试承重。
pages.en: Everyone carried stones, packed sand, and checked stability. Wukong used the staff only for the final gentle test.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] Wukong presses the upright staff gently onto a finished flat stepping stone while monkeys watch from the side; teamwork, no swinging.

pages.zh: 第一篮桃子稳稳通过，猴群欢呼。悟空也听见了山里新的笑声。
pages.en: The first peach basket crossed safely, and the mountain rang with new laughter.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] Monkeys carry a peach basket across the repaired broad stones while Wukong smiles and keeps the staff upright like a walking stick.

pages.zh: 晚上，悟空才讲起天庭见闻。他发现，最好的重聚，是彼此都有话可说。
pages.en: Only that evening did Wukong share his heavenly adventures. The best reunion gave everyone a turn to speak.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]] Warm evening in Water Curtain Cave: Wukong tells stories with open hands, staff safely resting in a wall rack, monkeys gathered with peaches.
